rows.label: VAT exemption on 20 basic items (2026 budget)
rows.value: VAT exemptions on 20 basic food and essential items (including cooking oils, kidney beans, lentils, toothpaste, toilet paper, soaps, baby and adult diapers and female sanitary products) are extended in 2026.

rows.value: VAT on electricity is reduced by 50% for households consuming 99 to 150 kWh a month.

rows.note: petrol and diesel (reduced rate maintained in 2026). Unit: per gallon.

sections.title: Property acquisition, transfer and registration taxes

rows.label: Property transfer tax: non-citizen buying land for an approved investment project
rows.note: purchaser who is not a citizen, buying land for exclusive use in a project eligible for the investment allowance (section 36A of the Income Tax Act).

rows.label: Property transfer tax: first transfer of a tourism-complex villa (vendor)
rows.note: first transfer of a villa or apartment in a tourism complex by the developer, on market value, payable by the vendor (plus 5% from a purchaser who is not a citizen).

rows.label: Property transfer tax: later transfer of a tourism-complex villa (vendor)
rows.note: subsequent transfer of a villa or apartment in a tourism complex, on market value, payable by the vendor (plus 2.5% from a purchaser who is not a citizen of Grenada).
